artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 4th plate
artworks.description: This image is an etching of an elderly man's face in profile. The man has a contemplative expression, deep-set eyes, a broad nose, furrowed eyebrows, a long white beard, and full head of hair. He is wearing a dark garment covering up to his neck. The background has a textured pattern, and the portrait is done in an etching style.

artworks.title: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a man. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, slightly turned to the right. The man has a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, and deep-set eyes. He has a long, thick beard, a mustache, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat that covers most of his hair. The man is wearing a collared shirt. The background is plain with slight discoloration on the paper surface, and the artist's signature "A. Legros" is in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Cardinal Manning, 2nd plate
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile portrait of an elderly man from the waist up. He is facing left, displaying distinct facial features such as deep-set eyes, a strong nose, and visible wrinkles. The man has sparse, closely cropped hair and wears a snug cap, with his ears outlined. There is no visible clothing detail, with the drawing focusing on shading and contouring. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the detailed pencil work on the subject.

artworks.title: Beggar with Hat in Hand (Mendiant avec son chapeau a la main)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body, seated with his head tilted downwards. He has a pronounced brow and a long beard. His hair is sparse and closely cropped. He is wearing a textured cloak or robe, holding a hat in one hand and resting it on his knee. In the background, there is a large, bare tree trunk with bare branches.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son, 4th plate (L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in bistre
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching showing a seated figure with a view slightly looking downwards. A large tree with textured brushstrokes is on the left, while a man is digging into the ground with a hoe in the foreground. The background shows outlines of low hills, trees, and structures blending into a sepia-toned backdrop.

artworks.title: Old Chateau (Un vieux chateau)
artworks.description: The etching depicts a landscape with homes among trees, with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is obscured by foliage and structures, creating depth. The artist used detailed etching techniques with cross-hatching and dense lines for texture and depth. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes the intricate lines and light and shadow contrasts. Tall trees frame the view, drawing attention to the buildings nestled between them. The scene is intricate and serene, inviting exploration of its textures.

artworks.title: Near the Mill (Pres du moulin)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a calm stream with a figure fishing on the bank. Tall trees line the opposite shore, leading to a distant horizon with soft lines indicating vegetation. The etching features intricate lines, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochrome palette of black and beige tones.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a serene riverside scene. In the foreground, a figure sits in a boat near the riverbank, wearing a hat. The background features a row of tall trees with a few hills in the distance. The composition is predominantly monochromatic, with shades of brown. The lines in the etching are delicate and controlled.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated against a stone or brick wall, leaning forward with his head resting on his arms crossed over his knees. He has a beard and wavy hair partially covering his face. He is wearing a tunic or robe and sandals. The background features a rough, textured surface and dense hatching indicating a stone wall or piles of stones or hay.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a male figure shown from the shoulders up in a reclined pose. He has facial hair and wavy hair, and wears a draped garment. There are hatch lines in the background for texture and shading.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouched position with their upper body leaning forward over their knees. The person's head is turned to the side, resting on their folded arms, which are propped against a pillow or soft surface. The person appears to be middle-aged, with relatively long hair and a full beard. They are wearing a loose-fitting tunic and simple shoes. The background consists of roughly textured, large, stacked blocks or stones. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or additional objects. The sketch is done in a cross-hatching style.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.description: The image features a person in a crouched or seated position on a surface, with knees bent and arms folded on the knees. The individual has medium-length, wavy hair and a beard, but their facial features are not fully visible. They are dressed in a long-sleeved garment and footwear, with a textured surface behind them. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Desperate Man (Le desespere)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated on a stone surface with his body slightly leaned forward. His head rests on his left hand, looking downward. He has a beard and unkempt hair, wearing a tunic, belt, and leggings. He holds a staff in his right hand, with foliage or rustic wall textures in the background.

artworks.title: Poplars near Amiens (Pres d'Amiens, les tourbieres)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water, grass, and reeds. Trees line the horizon, and there is a wooden structure on the water. The painting has fine brushstrokes and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Old Village (Ville vieille)
artworks.description: The scene shows a seated figure resting against a tree stump, with their back to the viewer. The figure is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and holding a staff, gazing into the landscape. The horizon is obscured by uneven terrain and trees. On the right, intricately rendered trees rise upwards, with fine etching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, using tones of sepia to create light and shadow. Cross-hatching and lines convey depth and texture. In the distance, undulating hills or rocky formations provide a sense of recession. The overall effect is serene and contemplative, with the natural elements interconnected through the artist's line work.

artworks.title: In the Forest of Conteville  (Dans la foret de Conteville)
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland with tall trees and a sunlit clearing in the distance. The view is from within the forest, and the horizon is covered by foliage. There is brighter light on the upper right side of the image, suggesting an open sky. The trees and foliage are detailed with cross-hatching and etching lines to add texture. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving a classic atmosphere. The tree trunks closer to the viewer are dark, while the clearing beyond is illuminated by filtered light.

artworks.title: Arrivee au Marche
artworks.medium: black chalk on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a road alongside a canal. The view is elevated, showing the road, canal, trees, and structures on the horizon. The style of the sketch is characterized by soft lines and shading, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Closest to us, a canal borders the road with some ducks in the water. Figures and carts are seen on the road leading into the distance.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: charcoal and colored chalk on laid blue-gray paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a wide view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is near the center, showing a row of trees and distant hills. Faint clouds mark the skyline. There are figures engaging in activity in the foreground. The sketchy brushstrokes emphasize details in black and white on a muted background. The color palette is mainly monochrome with hints of soft reddish-brown tones. The overall technique blends impressionistic and realistic elements, capturing the rural setting elegantly.

artworks.title: Saint Servan
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 17.8 x 22.7 cm (7 x 8 15/16 in.)
support: 25.9 x 30.5 cm (10 3/16 x 12 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a town next to a body of water. On the left, a path leads towards the buildings in the center, lined with a low fence. The town in the distance includes buildings of various sizes and shapes, including some towers and domes. One building at the end of the path has smoke curling from its chimney. On the right, a large, dark tower is at the end of a strip of land that juts into the water. Boats can be seen by the shore. There are low hills in the background under the empty sky. The drawing is done in soft gray lines on beige paper.

artworks.title: The House of the King of Poland (Angers)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash

artworks.title: The Departure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people walking in a line. The first person is a woman with her head bent forward and her hand lifted to her face. The second person is a man who walks with his head slightly bowed and holds something under his arm. The third figure is another woman carrying a basket. The individuals are not distinctly detailed, but the man has a beard and wears a hat, while the women have scarves covering their heads. They are clad in long dresses and cloaks. The background consists of tall trees, hills, and foliage, creating an outdoor, rural setting. The image is in sepia tones with pencil and chalk, giving a vintage look.

artworks.title: Boat in Trouble
artworks.medium: oil, casein coating, charcoal, and ink
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four figures, three adults, and one child, only partially visible from their waists up. The central figure is a woman inclined forward, positioned to the left, with her face in profile. She has a shawl covering her head. She wears a long dress and a draped shawl. Behind her to the right are two more figures, also wearing shawls. The child is directly in front of these two figures. The background is abstract and dark, with soft tones and indistinct shapes. The entire scene is rendered in muted brown tones with a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Study of Woman Praying
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with their head turned to the right and looking upward. They have large eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and full lips. Their head is covered with a headscarf or veil. The person is wearing a garment that drapes around the shoulders, with folds indicating fabric texture. Their hands are raised and together in a gesture that may suggest prayer. A ring is visible on their left hand. The background is plain, consisting only of the paper.
